settings_help_api_key: API key used for authenticated server connections.
settings_help_ask_for_title_confirmation: Prompt before replacing a conversation title with generated content.
settings_help_auto_show_sidebar_on_new_c: Open the sidebar automatically when starting a new chat.
settings_help_backend_sampling: Use server-side sampling instead of client-side sampling controls when available.
settings_help_copy_text_attachments_as_p: Copy text attachments without preserving markdown or formatting.
settings_help_custom_json: Additional JSON parameters merged into the request payload.
settings_help_disable_automatic_scroll: Prevent the chat view from automatically scrolling to the newest message.
settings_help_disable_reasoning_content_: Show reasoning output exactly as returned instead of parsing it into a dedicated block.
settings_help_exclude_reasoning_from_con: Exclude reasoning content from the conversation context sent back to the model.
settings_help_dry_allowed_length: Number of trailing tokens exempt from DRY penalties.
settings_help_dry_base: Base value used by the DRY sampling algorithm.
settings_help_dry_multiplier: Strength multiplier for DRY repetition penalties.
settings_help_dry_penalty_last_n: Number of recent tokens considered by DRY penalties.
settings_help_dynamic_temperature_expone: Controls how aggressively dynamic temperature responds.
settings_help_dynamic_temperature_range: Temperature adjustment range used by dynamic temperature sampling.
settings_help_enable_continue_button: Show a button that asks the model to continue generating the current response.
settings_help_enable_raw_output_toggle: Allow switching between parsed and raw model output in the UI.
settings_help_frequency_penalty: Penalize tokens that appear frequently in the response.
settings_help_keep_stats_visible: Keep token and timing statistics visible after generation finishes.
settings_help_language: Choose the UI language or follow the system default.
settings_help_max_lines_per_tool_preview: Maximum number of lines shown when previewing a tool result.
settings_help_max_tokens: Upper bound for generated tokens in a single response.
settings_help_min_p: Discard tokens whose probability falls below the minimum relative threshold.
settings_help_parse_pdf_as_image: Treat uploaded PDFs as images for multimodal models.
settings_help_paste_long_text_to_file_le: Convert pasted text longer than this threshold into a file attachment.
settings_help_pre_fill_kv_cache_after_re: After each response, pre-fill the server KV cache with the current conversation so the next turn starts faster.
settings_help_presence_penalty: Penalize tokens that have already appeared at least once.
settings_help_render_user_content_as_mar: Render your own messages using markdown formatting.
settings_help_repeat_last_n: How many recent tokens are considered for repeat penalties.
settings_help_repeat_penalty: Penalty applied when the model repeats recent tokens.
settings_help_samplers: Order of samplers to apply when backend sampling is disabled.
settings_help_send_message_on_enter: Use Enter to send messages and Shift + Enter for new lines. Disable this to use Ctrl/Cmd + Enter instead.
settings_help_show_message_generation_st: Display token counts and generation speed for each response.
settings_help_show_microphone_on_empty_i: Keep the microphone button visible when the input box is empty.
settings_help_show_raw_model_names: Display model identifiers exactly as reported by the server.
settings_help_show_thought_in_progress: Show reasoning or thinking content while the model is still generating.
settings_help_show_tool_call_in_progress: Show tool-call progress messages before the final tool output arrives.
settings_help_system_message: Default system prompt applied to new conversations.
settings_help_temperature: Higher values make output more random; lower values make it more focused.
settings_help_theme: Choose light, dark, or follow the system appearance.
settings_help_top_k: Sample only from the top K most likely next tokens.
settings_help_top_p: Sample from the smallest token set whose cumulative probability reaches this value.
settings_help_use_full_height_code_block: Expand code blocks to use the available vertical space.
